ciRuns.rule: One run per push to main from the commit that added the workflow (11 Aug 2026). Commits that touch website/register.* live on feature/registration-form and have no run. Two runs are re-runs of the same commit.

gap.question: Which build does the latest GitHub release hold, and is main releasable right now?
gap.answer: Main has been red since 5 Nov: the last 4 runs all failed at 'pio test -e native'. The workflow runs that step before the build and the release step, so none of them attached a firmware.bin. The latest release is the one from run 30 on 3 Nov (commit 64986c4), which is v2.4.0 code. The encoder filter commits of 5 Nov and 10 Nov are not in any release, and firmware/src/version.h has not changed since 26 Oct, so the boot banner check in docs/DEPLOY.md cannot tell the builds apart.
gap.whyOnlyRunsAndWorkflow: No chat message, note, task or document says which runs failed, at which step, or which commit the latest release was built from. The workflow file gives the order of the steps; the run history gives the outcome per commit.

trigger.containsText: Actions shows red on the last few pushes to main. Not sure which build the release page has now.
